title: Fisherman's Path
description: A narrow path leading to a small hut. The sea breeze is fresh.

title: Fisherman's Hut
description: A modest wooden hut. An old fisherman sits on a chair.

title: Lake
description: A calm lake. A dead end. Nothing moves here.

title: Road to Village
description: The path widens, leading towards the village.

title: Village
description: An abandoned village. Two fishwalkers lurk.

title: Village Gate
description: A rusty gate blocks the way. You can hear noises from inside the village.
